mapper.select: select type, param_key, param_value, updated_by, updated_at from runtime_config where type = #{type} order by param_key
mapper.insert:
insert into runtime_config ( type, param_key, param_value, updated_by, updated_at ) values
( #{entry.type}, #{entry.paramKey}, #{entry.paramValue}, #{entry.updatedBy}, #{entry.updatedAt} )
on duplicate key update param_value = values(param_value), updated_by = values(updated_by), updated_at = values(updated_at)
